name: CableDyn
description: An open-source, geometrically exact cable and mooring dynamics solver: Cosserat-rod finite elements with generalised-α time integration, Morison loading, Facchinetti VIV, and a CableXsec interface. Benchmarked against MoorDyn-F, MoorDyn-C, and OrcaFlex. An OpenFAST interface is planned.

name: CableXsec
description: An Apache-2.0 Python library for thermo-mechanical cross-section fatigue analysis of dynamic power cables and SURF. Seven model levels, from Love and Costello kinematics through Witz–Tan to DNVGL-RP-0005.

name: VANE
description: Automated OpenFAST linearisation post-processing: MBC3 transformation, eigenanalysis, MAC and Hungarian mode tracking, Campbell diagrams, and clean state-space (A, B, C, D) export for digital twin development of fixed-bottom and floating offshore wind turbines.

name: FOWCON
description: A gain-scheduled, damage-aware LQR DISCON runtime for floating offshore wind turbines.

name: openfast-gui
description: A PySide6 and Qt6 desktop application for building and editing OpenFAST input decks, with the MoorDyn module prioritised.

name: moordyn-io
description: Programmatic reading, writing, and validation of MoorDyn v2 input files.

name: pyBModes
description: A Python finite-element library for wind turbine blade and tower modal analysis, targeting OpenFAST and ElastoDyn. Also distributed through conda-forge.

name: pyIECWind
description: A Python package for IECWind-style IEC wind condition generation for OpenFAST InflowWind.

name: OpenFAST, ROSCO and TurbSim syntax highlighting for VS Code
description: Syntax highlighting for OpenFAST input files and ROSCO controller input files in Visual Studio Code.
